## FlexiKnee GitHub source connection
Manual, read-only workflow. No GitHub token or LLM call.

Repository Config defaults to main. During PR testing, explicitly select the draft branch. The output records the exact commit and never claims production deployment was verified.

The source blob hashes must match the same commit. Regenerate the inventory after changing the registered source files. Do not treat empty Shopify SEO/alt fields as proof of missing live metadata.

Anonymous GitHub API limits apply. This workflow is not scheduled.
